note: same labelling rules as labels_W_gptoss.json (me, against the findings file; not blind, labelled after the default-effort set). defect = unit with an unsupported, overstated, mismatched or wrong statement. Severity 1 outside background/extrapolation, 2 misleading in a way a careful reader could catch, 3 would mislead a scientist acting on it.

defects: 'roughly twice the magnitude' sets two SMDs against each other sev2
'authors explicitly noted' a non-comparison the paper never discusses sev1
'limited by the small number of trials' not in findings sev1
'raised the hazard ratio by 1.11' wording sev1
'associated with advanced CKD stages' in conclusion sev2
'may underestimate true prevalence' overstates exploratory trim-and-fill sev2
'limited power to detect subtle changes' invented sev1
GGTA1 result placed under CMAH heading, ambiguous sev1
'synergistic ... repeated electroporation and ZP removal' (paper says repeated electroporation and timing) sev2

'model-specific within a dataset' garbles 'comparable across models within a dataset' sev2
'emphasises peak performance rather than typical' sev1
'directly sourced therefore internally consistent' non sequitur sev1
absence of overall ranking framed as a flaw against the paper's stated aim sev2
'Table 3 corroborates ... energy savings consistent' papers over text-energy vs table-memory mismatch sev2
'the paper notes that the units differ' sev1
'multivariate quantile regression' wrong expansion of MMQR sev2
